learningSpec.productPurpose: Compare redacted webhook payloads with safe TypeScript event contracts on the local machine.
targetUsers: TypeScript developers learning external event contracts
learningSpec.primaryUsageMoment: Before implementing a webhook handler for an unfamiliar provider.
learningSpec.successMoment: A pasted payload matches one typed variant and explains every rejected field.

scope.title: Typed event variant matching
scope.rationale: The core interaction depends on narrowing a payload to one safe event type.

scope.title: Local UI shell
scope.rationale: The interface is necessary to try samples but is not the target learning goal.

scope.title: Live provider and hosted storage
scope.rationale: Credentials and hosted payload retention would expand the security and deployment boundary.

expectedDecisions.description: Choose whether unknown fields are rejected immediately or retained for inspection.
expectedDecisions.whyUserInputMatters: The choice changes whether the tool optimizes for strict safety or debugging visibility.

deploymentConstraints: Local reproducible execution only for MVP
